jobs.title: Compliance Officer
jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Pictet has been present in Singapore for more than 30 years where it employs over 200 people.

The Compliance function is responsible for helping Pictet’s senior management manage the compliance risks faced by Pictet. This role will focus on the risks faced by Pictet’s Singapore bank, Banque Pictet & Cie SA (BPSA) Singapore Branch.

The AML/CFT Compliance Officer is part of the team that oversees the Bank’s financial crime framework, focused primarily on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance. The incumbent performs systematic AML/CFT reviews on high-risk clients before onboarding and subsequent periodic reviews, reviews alerts/issues escalated by first-line functions and reports suspicions of criminal or sanctioned activity, and provides advice on AML/CFT and sanctions management. . The officer monitors changes that may impact the business, working with business and support functions to ensure that the Bank complies with regulatory obligations and Group standards in the financial crime area. The role will report to the Compliance AML Lead.

Your role

Key responsibilities

-Investigate relevant alerts and suspicious activities, and perform filing of STR to local authorities.
-Perform ex-ante AML reviews on high-risk client onboarding and periodic reviews.
-Review escalated alerts from first-line transaction monitoring, payment filtering and ongoing name screening controls.
-Support external requests include production orders, due diligence queries and any relevant regulatory reporting (e.g. Remote Gambling Act reporting).
-Act as an expert advisor to business and support functions on compliance and regulatory matters related to AML/CFT and international sanctions management.
-Perform an annual AML/CFT Enterprise-wide Risk Assessment (EWRA) identifying risks and framework/control gaps to the attention of management and Group -Compliance.
-Assist with periodical risk-based design and operating effectiveness testing of first-line AML/CFT controls, including on lower-risk clients.
-Represent Compliance as needed on financial crime related projects and initiatives.
-Assist in the resolution of Compliance-owned management action plans from audits, inspections and Group reviews.
-Produce relevant management information reports to board and senior management on the governance of financial crime risks.
-Build and maintain a proactive and constructive relationship with business and functional stakeholders to ensure appropriate controls are in place for financial crime risk identification and management.
-Keep abreast and understand the impact of new financial crime regulations and where needed, represent the Bank in industry consultations.
-Support the Singapore AML Lead on all AML/CFT matters and any other duties as assigned.

Your profile

-Bachelor Degree in law, banking or business.
-Working knowledge of the CDSA, AML/CFT typologies, relevant MAS Regulations and Guidance on AML/CFT and the international sanctions framework.
-Working experience of Singapore regulatory landscape and expectations needed. Familiarity with regulations and guidance in an AML, Financial crime Compliance role.
-6-10 years of relevant experience in AML/CFT compliance particularly on investigations.
-Prior experience in a similar role in a Private Bank will be advantageous.
-Highly effective verbal and written communication and organizational skills.

-Ability to multi-task competing priorities while maintaining a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
-Capable of working with cross-functional and senior stakeholders.
-Sense of accountability, good time management and ability to meet tight deadlines.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

Dein Team Die Pictet-Gruppe ist einer der weltweit führenden unabhängigen Vermögensverwalter. Pictet ist seit mehr als 30 Jahren in Singapur präsent und beschäftigt dort über 200 Mitarbeiter. Die Compliance-Funktion ist dafür verantwortlich, die Geschäftsleitung von Pictet bei der Steuerung der Compliance-Risiken zu unterstützen, denen Pictet ausgesetzt ist. Diese Rolle wird sich auf die Risiken der Pictet-Bank in Singapur, Banque Pictet & Cie SA (BPSA) Singapore Branch, konzentrieren. Der AML/CFT Compliance Officer ist Teil des Teams, das den Finanzkriminalitätsrahmen der Bank überwacht, der sich hauptsächlich auf die Einhaltung von AML/CFT und Sanktionen konzentriert. Der etablierte Betreiber führt systematische AML / CFT-Überprüfungen bei Kunden mit hohem Risiko vor dem Onboarding und anschließende regelmäßige Überprüfungen durch, überprüft Warnungen / Probleme, die durch Erstlinienfunktionen eskaliert wurden, und meldet Verdacht auf kriminelle oder sanktionierte Aktivitäten und berät Sie zum AML / CFT- und Sanktionsmanagement. Der leitende Angestellte überwacht Änderungen, die sich auf das Geschäft auswirken können, und arbeitet mit Geschäfts- und Unterstützungsfunktionen zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Bank die regulatorischen Verpflichtungen und Gruppenstandards im Bereich der Finanzkriminalität einhält. Die Rolle wird an den Compliance AML Lead berichten. Deine Rolle Hauptzuständigkeiten -Untersuchen Sie relevante Warnungen und verdächtige Aktivitäten und führen Sie die Einreichung von STR an lokale Behörden durch. Führen Sie Ex-ante-AML-Bewertungen zum Onboarding von Kunden mit hohem Risiko und regelmäßige Überprüfungen durch. -Überprüfung eskalierter Warnmeldungen aus der First-Line-Transaktionsüberwachung, Zahlungsfilterung und laufenden Kontrolle der Namensüberprüfung. Support externe Anfragen umfassen Produktionsaufträge, Due Diligence Anfragen und alle relevanten regulatorischen Berichte (z. B. Remote Gambling Act Reporting). Als fachkundiger Berater für Geschäfts- und Supportfunktionen in Compliance- und Regulierungsfragen im Zusammenhang mit AML / CFT und internationalem Sanktionsmanagement fungieren. Führen Sie eine jährliche AML / CFT Enterprise-wide Risk Assessment (EWRA) durch, um Risiken und Rahmen- / Kontrolllücken für das Management und die Gruppen-Compliance zu identifizieren. Unterstützung bei regelmäßigen risikobasierten Design- und Betriebseffektivitätstests von First-Line-AML/CFT-Kontrollen, einschließlich bei Kunden mit geringerem Risiko. -Repräsentieren Sie bei Bedarf Compliance bei Projekten und Initiativen im Zusammenhang mit Finanzkriminalität. Unterstützung bei der Lösung von Compliance-eigenen Management-Aktionsplänen aus Audits, Inspektionen und Gruppenbewertungen. Erstellung relevanter Management-Informationsberichte an Vorstand und Geschäftsleitung zur Steuerung von Finanzkriminalitätsrisiken. Aufbau und Pflege einer proaktiven und konstruktiven Beziehung zu Unternehmen und funktionalen Stakeholdern, um sicherzustellen, dass angemessene Kontrollen für die Identifizierung und das Management von Finanzkriminalitätsrisiken vorhanden sind. -Halten Sie sich auf dem Laufenden und verstehen Sie die Auswirkungen neuer Vorschriften für Finanzkriminalität und vertreten Sie die Bank bei Bedarf in Branchenberatungen. Unterstützen Sie den Singapur AML Lead in allen AML / CFT-Angelegenheiten und allen anderen zugewiesenen Aufgaben. Dein Profil Bachelor-Abschluss in Law, Banking oder Business. Kenntnisse der CDSA, der AML/CFT-Typologien, der einschlägigen MAS-Verordnungen und der Leitlinien für AML/CFT und des internationalen Sanktionsrahmens. -Arbeitserfahrung in Singapur Regulierungslandschaft und Erwartungen erforderlich. Vertrautheit mit Vorschriften und Leitlinien in einer AML, Financial Crime Compliance Rolle. -6-10 Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung in der Einhaltung von AML/CFT, insbesondere bei Untersuchungen. -Vorherige Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Rolle in einer Privatbank wird von Vorteil sein. -Hochwirksame verbale und schriftliche Kommunikation und organisatorische Fähigkeiten. Fähigkeit, konkurrierende Prioritäten mit mehreren Aufgaben zu bearbeiten und gleichzeitig ein hohes Maß an Genauigkeit und Aufmerksamkeit für Details beizubehalten. -Fähig zur Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden und leitenden Stakeholdern. -Gefühl der Rechenschaftspflicht, gutes Zeitmanagement und Fähigkeit, enge Fristen einzuhalten. Produire des rapports d'information de gestion pertinents au conseil d'administration et à la haute direction sur la gouvernance des risques de criminalité financière. -Construire et maintenir des relations proactives et constructives avec les intervenants opérationnels et fonctionnels afin de s'assurer que des contrôles appropriés sont en place pour identifier et gérer les risques de criminalité financière. -Tenir au courant et comprendre l'impact des nouveaux règlements sur la criminalité financière et, au besoin, représenter la Banque dans les consultations de l'industrie. - The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people.

Your role

The Taiwan Intermediary sales team is currently made up of professionals who prospect and service intermediary clients throughout Taiwan by marketing Pictet Asset Management’s (Pictet AM) strategies.

Reporting to the Head of Sales - Taiwan, you will play a critical role in Pictet AM’s drive to further develop its business in Taiwan. Your responsibilities will be:

• Foster strong collaborative relationships with distributors and financial advisors to boost sales activities.

• Address and assist distributors' headquarters and clients in resolving product and market-related inquiries while nurturing relationships.

• Organize seminars and meetings to facilitate engagement and knowledge sharing.

• Actively participate in fund sales initiatives and strive to partner with distributors in campaigns to achieve the company's business goals and increase brand awareness.

• Regularly visit branches for fund promotion and training.

• Gather, organize, analyse, and share market intelligence related to distributors and industry peers.

• Contribute to the development of effective sales strategies based on market insights.

• Proactively carry out tasks assigned by the sales head, ensuring efficient and accurate completion of various assignments.

jobs.title: Client Register Specialist
jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.
By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

As part of the Client Register team , you will contribute to the management and integrity of client data, supporting the bank’s core operations and ensuring a high standard of service for internal stakeholders and client-facing teams, without direct contact with clients.

Your main responsibilities will include managing the opening and closing of customer accounts for the bank and its branches, as well as handling credit card administration for customers. This involves updating static data and the services selected by our clients and performing “Cotation” tasks such as signature verification.

In addition, you will play a central role in the transformation of our activities by driving the identification, implementation, and optimization of automation and digitalization solutions for our processes. jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 600 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units, and include Communications, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Organisation & Digital, Risk and Tax departments.

The Corporate Compliance Officer participates in monitoring the company's activities to ensure compliance with applicable regulations and also takes part in the implementation of the CMP (Control Monitoring Plan). He also ensures the strengthening of the company's procedural and training framework.

Your role

• Analyze regulatory watch screenings performing gap analysis on new regulations and assess their potential impact within the company.

• Contribute to the development and implementation of the Compliance Monitoring Plan by identifying applicable compliance standards and monitoring controls using a risk-based approach.

• Identify and assess compliance risks to which the company is exposed, make appropriate observations, and verify appropriate follow up on related to identified issues with the different stakeholders.

• Assist in establishing and maintaining a compliance manual, ensuring that all internal policies and procedures comply with legal requirements and group minimum standards.

• Assist in the training of new employees on compliance topics and ensure that compliance training is conducted at defined intervals.

• Participate in regulatory projects by providing advice on legal requirements and ensuring that delivered solutions comply with regulations and minimum group standards.

• Maintain and update various registers, including investor complaints, conflicts of interest, personal transactions, gifts, and identified issues.

• Follow up on audit recommendations and participate in the proper implementation.

• Collaborate with regulators and the Ministry of Finance to ensure compliance and respond to regulatory requests.

Your profile

Request experience:

• Bachelor or Master degree in compliance, legal or related field.

• 3 to 5 years of experience in a equivalent role.

Technical skills:

• Good knowledge of European and Luxembourgish regulations.

• Understanding of the operational mechanisms of a management company and the associated regulatory framework.

• Good knowledge of the industry of Fund and Asset Management.

• Ability to perform controls. Former experience on audit (external or internal) is a plus.

• Written and oral communication skills.

Soft skills:

• Discretion, rigor, and reliability.

• Analytical skills and critical thinking.

• Good organizational and priority management skills.

• Ability to navigate complex and constantly evolving environments

Language skills:

• French: fluent

• English: fluent

Note

We will not accept any CVs from agencies.

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

Flexible and modern ways of working

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave.

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) is a leading alternative investment asset manager that is part of of the Pictet Group, with a focus on private equity, real estate private credit and hedge funds. Pictet Group currently has more than €50bn of AUM in alternatives and more than €25bn of private equity AUM.

Pictet launched its first direct private equity fund in 2023, with a focus on mid market European buyout investments, raising over EUR 430m. The fund operates out of London and focuses on long-term, partnership-based investments in B2B Services, Education & Training, and Industrials o across the UK and the DACH region.

You will be part of a team of 13 professionals. As the fund is now in active deployment, we are looking to expand our origination capability and hire an Origination Professional dedicated to the UK lower mid-market.

Your role

As a key member of the direct private equity team, you will be responsible for generating a consistent, high-quality pipeline of proprietary acquisition opportunities in the UK lower mid-market (£2–10m EBITDA, owner-managed businesses). The role combines direct founder outreach as well as corporate finance adviser coverage supporting the team’s thematic investment priorities, and the development of a modern origination tech stack. Your responsibilities will include:

Direct Thematic Origination:

• Conduct structured mapping of companies within sub-sectors aligned to the fund's thematic priorities;

• Run structured multi-channel outreach to founder-led businesses;

• Travel across the UK to meet entrepreneurs, qualify opportunities against investment criteria, and nurture longer-term prospects through structured CRM-driven relationship management;

• Evaluate and deploy new origination tools to scale the firm's sourcing edge.

Adviser & Intermediary Coverage:

• Build and maintain active dialogue with regional advisers, corporate finance boutiques and accountants who advise owner-managed businesses on exit;

• Travel regularly across UK regions to meet advisers, and position the fund consistently to ensure it is top of mind for upcoming sale mandates.

Your profile

• University degree from a strong institution; degree subject is secondary to drive, judgement and origination instinct.

• 7-10 years total work experience including 2-5 years in a role centred on direct, regular contact with business owners and senior decision-makers in the UK - origination, business development or cold-outreach experience is essential.

• Origination experience at a UK private equity firm or in mid-market corporate finance advisory is strongly preferred; alternative backgrounds will be considered where strong personal attributes and origination experience are present.

• Visible origination energy: a resourceful and resilient self-starter with high activity levels, comfortable with cold approaches, the phone, and regular UK travel.

• Genuine people person: builds rapport naturally with founders of owner-managed businesses, demonstrating maturity and commercial judgement, and earns trust quickly with intermediaries.

• Fluent in modern origination technology (CRM, AI tools and outreach platforms), actively curious about deploying new tools to scale proprietary sourcing.

Beyond professional skills, the ideal candidate should demonstrate hunger and smart hustle - high output paired with sharp prioritisation - alongside commercial judgement, integrity in handling sensitive founder and adviser conversations, and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving.

As the chosen candidate, you'll have the unique opportunity to join one of the world's leading private financial institutions. You'll be embedded in an ambitious direct investments team, working in a dynamic "start-up" environment while benefiting from the support of experienced senior professionals within the PAA team and the broader Pictet Group.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

With teams based globally, PAA constructs, manages and advises portfolios of alternative investment solutions for institutional and private clients.

You will be part of a team covering the full life cycle of PAA employees globally.
